speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms are concerning; have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool appearance recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The weight loss and night sweats are significant; have you noticed any blood in your stool or unintentional bleeding elsewhere? Also, have you experienced any persistent fever or night sweats specifically waking you up?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP), and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR).

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: The results from your blood work show pancytopenia with leukopenia and thrombocytopenia, along with markedly elevated inflammatory markers. Given your B symptoms and abdominal pain, have you noticed any new lumps in your neck or armpits, or any difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastric Lymphoma (MALT lymphoma) with secondary pancytopenia due to marrow infiltration or splenic sequestration.

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound and CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast.
